== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Tiree (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. Compared with [[Tiree (PC Errata 2015 disc card)]]. The same area of the earlier card image (scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
